# Source template: common/scripted_triggers/bca_empire_economic_needs.txt.j2
bca_empire_needs_energy = {
    owner = {
        OR = {
            NOT = { has_country_flag = bca_enable_economic_management }
            has_country_flag = bca_economic_target_energy_unlimited
            AND = {
                NOT = { has_country_flag = bca_economic_target_energy_forbidden }
                resource_income_compare = {
                    resource = energy
                    value < bca_expect_output_energy
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

bca_empire_needs_research = {
    owner = {
        OR = {
            NOT = { has_country_flag = bca_enable_economic_management }
            has_country_flag = bca_economic_target_research_unlimited
            AND = {
                NOT = { has_country_flag = bca_economic_target_research_forbidden }
                check_variable_arithmetic = {
                    which = value:bca_total_research_revenue
                    value < bca_expect_output_research

            }
        }
    }
